title: evolve inbox show names the held-for-operator state of an item whose cycle is held
summary: When the claimed item of cycle N has a record .evolve/landing/held/cycle-N.json with the status held-for-operator, evolve inbox show prints the state and the cycle, and evolve inbox list marks it.
acceptance: evolve inbox show of a held item prints held-for-operator and the cycle; an item of a cycle that is not held prints its old status.
A test with a fixture hold record covers both branches.
notes: Route lane: the files are read-only views and are not on the fence. The item reads the hold record and writes nothing.
